neighbours.label: a verbless fragment sentence opened by a quantity or negation word ('Lots of X.', 'No fuss, no Y.', 'Not a scratch.', 'Très peu de X', 'Ni golpes'); the same words inside a full clause are quiet
fire: The beach was lovely in June. Lots of space, hardly any wind.
Setup took five minutes. No tools, no glue, no stress.
The laptop survived the fall. Not a crack, not a mark on it.
Le repas était décevant. Très peu de choix, pas de dessert.
El paquete llegó perfecto. Ni roturas, ni humedad.
The hostel was basic. No towels, no soap, no hot water.
The concert was magical. Tons of energy and plenty of old songs.
We checked the car after the storm. Not a single dent.
quiet: The beach was lovely in June because it had lots of space.
Setup took five minutes and did not need any tools.
The laptop survived the fall and did not have a crack on it.
Le repas était décevant parce que le choix était limité.
El paquete llegó perfecto y no tenía roturas.
The hostel was basic and did not provide towels or soap.
The concert was magical, and the band played plenty of old songs.
We checked the car after the storm and it did not have a dent.

notes: Card: peaks on ' of' (Lots of), ' de' (peu de / pas de), 'ой' (Никакой), ' hassle' (No hassle), 'pes' (Ni golpes). Probes: 'Not a scratch, not a dent' 0.97, 'Très peu de ... pas de' 0.93, 'Ni golpes, ni manchas' 0.67, 'Lots of families came' 0.62, 'No fuss, no cables' 0.36; 'because lots of families came' 0.12, 'without any cables' 0.08.
